hook: This npm package installed an AI agent backdoor

beats.say: A fake CRM client on npm, called leadstack crm-connect, installed Hermes Agent, an open-source AI agent, and wired it to the attacker's Telegram bot.
It ran as a system service, as root if npm install ran as root. From a chat, the attacker could run shell commands, edit files, browse and schedule jobs.
Nine versions went up on November 16. SafeDep flagged it five minutes after the last release and npm removed it, but the publisher is still active.
